items.title: Thermal performance of an automobile radiator using nanofluids
CFD analysis of jet impingement on deflector configurations

nova-services.title: Skills and expertise
nova-services.description: Simulation, design and analysis tools I use to take a component from CAD model to validated result.

items.title: Computational Fluid Dynamics
items.description: Flow, pressure and temperature studies in ANSYS Fluent, from jet impingement on deflectors to nanofluid-cooled radiators.

items.title: Thermal and structural analysis
items.description: Heat transfer and stress analysis with ANSYS Workbench and APDL, evaluating components under thermal and mechanical loads.

items.title: CAD design
items.description: 3D modelling and drafting in AutoCAD, CATIA, SolidWorks and Fusion 360, with a focus on aerospace propulsion and airframe parts.

items.title: Programming and tools
items.description: Python fundamentals for image processing, Power BI and Microsoft Excel for data, plus RPA with UiPath and video editing.

nova-team.title: About me
nova-team.description: I am an Aerospace Engineering graduate (B.Tech, Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, 2022 to 2026). Through four internships I have worked on rocket propulsion, drone design and piloting, and CFD and thermal analysis for aerospace communication systems.
nova-team.imageAlt: Quadcopter drone modelled in CATIA by Majeesh S
checks: CFD and Thermal Analysis for Aerospace Communication Systems, CABS (DRDO)
Rocket Propulsion and Drone Design Internships, Brahmastra Aerospace Systems

faq3.title: Quick facts
faq3.description: Answers to the questions recruiters and collaborators ask most often.

items.a: B.Tech in Aerospace Engineering from Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences (2022 to 2026). Schooling at St. Joseph's Matric Hr. Sec. School (2008 to 2022).
CABS (DRDO) for CFD and thermal analysis of aerospace communication systems, Brahmastra Aerospace Systems for rocket propulsion and drone design, and Garuda Aerospace as a drone pilot.

items.q: Which simulation and CAD tools do you use?
items.a: ANSYS Workbench, ANSYS Fluent and APDL for simulation; AutoCAD, CATIA, SolidWorks and Fusion 360 for CAD; OpenRocket for rocket design.

items.q: What kind of work are you looking for?
items.a: Roles in CFD, thermal and structural simulation and design optimisation, applied to aerospace and propulsion challenges.
